title: Fluted prism
description: Sculptural color bends behind a sheet of ribbed architectural glass.
useCase: Layer original brand artwork with tactile glass distortion while keeping text on a separate plane.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Analytic refraction of included procedural art; it does not refract arbitrary page DOM.
look: Off-white vertical fluted glass over a vermilion disc, a black disc and a diagonal cobalt bar, each sliced and offset by the ribs.
motion: The red disc drifts slowly side to side on a roughly 30 s sine cycle behind fixed glass ribs; the refraction slider widens each flute's sideways displacement.
adapt: Everything is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `scene` paints the artwork behind the glass, `(p.x+.04)*13.0` sets flute density and `u_control` scales the bend. Replace the shapes in `scene`; keep `sg-fluted-prism-fallback` and the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
